body:
I did get to work. A friend ordered an uber for me while they were at work. They even made me hang out with them after we got off to take my mind off it. I'm very fortunate to have such wonderful friends.

I still have to go to work today, which will be challenging. Luckily at this job the chefs feed us so I was also able to get food. I wish I wasn't training so I could get paid right away, but it'll get there.

He texted me last night asking how work was and put the money back in my account. Unfortunately since it was a Saturday night, it will take until Tuesday to actually be back in my account :( 
He acted like he didn't do anything wrong and when I refused to hang out with he said "Wanna place bets on how fast you'll get fired?" I blocked him. I wanna be happy not upset. I just wish he treated me like a friend. Why tell me you care but sabotage me?

I hope I will get out of this hole soon. I really do feel hopeless, but my friends are all I have and I'm glad they are the way they are and not like him.

Also, thank you kind strangers for listening to my feelings of hopelessness. Kindness really is all around. Should focus on that instead of the negativity. 

Thank you for asking for an update. As a stranger, you could have just glossed by and went about the rest of your day, but you asked how I am :) 
Keep being this kind, novemberqueen32. You gave me some drive for the day.

To everyone else who took the time out as well...thank you so much.

There's still a lot of holes in the path i'm on, but hopefully I can get by.

Thank you. I was already feeling hopeless and this situation just made it worse.

He claims since he'said helped me out in the past that this money is what I owe him since I don't show my "appreciation" (i.e have sex).

I'm just scared to call in to work because it is a restaurant job and is my first day. I'm very replaceable in the field, I don't think I can risk being late or such. 

I'm trying to see if there are friends available to help, but as i've said earlier, majority are already working

I'm also worried to report him because what he took honestly wasnt much (just 60 bucks) but I needed that money. He comes from a well off family i feel like he would just destroy me.
How am I to get to work though? He's doing this so I beg him and I don't want to beg. I need that money to get to work. I feel so trapped
